title: Design: invoice dates in the Expanded exports match the screen
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have a work order for that customer with one labor line, one part, "Sales Representative - Labor" set to sales rep A and "Sales Representative - Parts" set to sales rep B, and invoice it today.
  • Set the browser window to 1440 pixels wide with the zoom at 100%.
  • Open the design pictures "sbr-10-a4-sbr-expanded-type.png" (board 4.10), "sbr-11-a4-export-csv.png" (board 4.11) and "sbr-12-a4-export-pdf-crop-1.png" (board 4.12) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in that browser window, with the date range set to today and Show Unassigned on.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Expand sales rep A.
  2. Expand sales rep B and write down the Date on the work order's two invoice rows.
  3. Export the Expanded CSV and read the Date of the same two rows.
  4. Export the Expanded PDF and read the Date of the same two rows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales rep A's invoice rows show.

Step 2:

  • Both rows show the same date.

Step 3:

  • The CSV shows the same date as the screen on both rows.

Step 4:

  • The PDF shows the same date as the screen on both rows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: Chris Ward's answers, question sheet of 19 Oct 2026, Google Sheet 17Ry1BtRTPEkecBP5TlgAE0T93Ai1TQewdJ7B7WpWDBQ, tab "Questions for Chris", rows 6-43 (answered 19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • Chris Ward's answer 33: “33. (b) A mistake in the design's sample data; the dates must match.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 4.10 Expanded with Sales Type; 4.11 Expanded export (CSV); 4.12 Expanded export (PDF) (the attached pictures are these boards).

Where the design and the PRD differ: In the design the same invoices read Sep 28 2026 on screen (board 4.10) and Sep 29 2026 in the CSV and the PDF (boards 4.11 and 4.12). Chris Ward ruled this a mistake in the design's sample data: the dates must match (answer 33).

Design pictures attached to this case: sbr-10-a4-sbr-expanded-type.png, sbr-11-a4-export-csv.png, sbr-12-a4-export-pdf-crop-1.png.

S1-12: Devon "Parts" ($266.18), Elliot "Labor" ($2,186.82), shop supplies ($175.50) with Labor (decision 37).” “At 1600px wide, the columns after Parts Margin scroll under the pinned Subtotal; production behaves the same.”
